f.ab.aa.body: וְ, וּ,וָ, demonstr.adv. and conj. so, then, and And The ו consecutive With a voluntative (cohort. or juss.) וְ expresses an intention that or so that It often expresses an informal inference, or consequence, so, then, esp. at the beginning of a speech ו introduces the predicate or apodosis
